authority: Weekly reserve period coefficients on core TRC, using scalar null-imposed restricted-score dependent-wild-bootstrap inference with a separate declared calibration.
declaration_note: Periods, widths, margin, cells and standard follow the consult and are frozen before this run. They are not historically results-blind: earlier weekly era estimates and the consult's probes were inspected.

period_basis.scarce_reserves: Ends 2008-09-10, the last Wednesday before the September 15, 2008 change after which the Desk could no longer drain the reserves created by liquidity provision (FRBNY, Domestic Open Market Operations During 2008).
period_basis.transition_2008: 2008-09-17 through 2008-12-17; the December 16, 2008 target-range decision ends it. Shown, not interpreted.
period_basis.floor_2008_2015: First wholly subsequent Thursday-Wednesday week after December 16, 2008 through the week before the December 17, 2015 implementation change.
period_basis.post_liftoff: From the first wholly subsequent week after December 17, 2015 (liftoff with the ON RRP directive) to the weekly endpoint. Not a claim that reserve conditions were homogeneous.
period_basis.pre_strains: Nested sensitivity ending 2007-08-08, before the August 9, 2007 onset of money-market strains (FRBNY, Domestic Open Market Operations During 2007).

estimand: Treatment coordinate of the projection of the period's weekly H.4.1 reserve change on core TRC and the calendar controls; a weekly core-TRC association distinct from the quarterly preferred-TRC coefficient.

inference.statistic: T(b) = (beta_hat - b) / s(b); s(b)^2 is the Bartlett long-run variance (calendar distance) of the scores a_t * e_b,t / (1 - h_t), with e_b the residual of y - b x on the controls, h the control leverage and a = x_perp / x_perp'x_perp.
inference.bootstrap: y* = b x + Z gamma_b + v * e_b / (1 - h), v Gaussian moving-average multipliers on the full weekly calendar with Cov = max(1 - d/(L+1), 0). In every draw the restricted control fit of y* - b x and its HC3/Bartlett scale are recomputed and T*(b) formed the same way.
inference.closed_form: beta_hat* - b and the draw's restricted residual are linear in b. Every long-run variance is the squared norm of a Bartlett factor (calendar moving sums of L+1 weeks over sqrt(L+1)), so Q(b) = (R00 - b R01)^2 + (b R11)^2 from a 2x2 QR and cannot cancel; T(b) = (beta_hat - b)/sqrt(Q(b)), T*(b) = (c_u - b c_x)/sqrt(Q*(b)). A scale whose factored columns are collinear to working precision is unresolved and no p-value is reported. The implementation is tested against an explicit per-draw refit.
inference.confidence_sets: Inversion to a declared resolution: candidate breakpoints are all real roots of the per-draw quartics (c_e/s - u c_x)^2 q_R(u) - u^2 q_D(u) in standard-error units u = (b - beta_hat)/s, plus a - b, a, a + b for near-real complex pairs a +/- bi (which may be perturbed real pairs); the direct test is evaluated at every candidate and every midpoint, and each acceptance change is located by bisection on the direct test to 1e-10 relative in standard-error units. Components narrower than 1e-8 standard errors in absolute terms (or than four units of floating-point spacing at their location, which binds only beyond about 1e7 standard errors), including isolated accepted points (probability zero, undecidable in floating point), are not reported; the component containing beta_hat is always reported. Disconnected and unbounded sets are kept; the set always contains beta_hat; a dense independent check stops the run on any disagreement between the set and the direct test.
inference.equivalence: Two one-sided 5% tests: H0 beta <= -0.10 rejected when the upper-tail p at -0.10 is at most 0.05; H0 beta >= 0.10 rejected when the lower-tail p at 0.10 is at most 0.05; equivalence only if both reject and the one-sided tests pass calibration.

calibration.streams: SeedSequence([seed, period_index, width, cell_index]).spawn(2): one stream for errors, one for multipliers
calibration.location_invariance: T(b) depends on y only through y - b x, so coverage and one-sided rejection at the exact projection target do not depend on the coefficient level; every cell is evaluated at its exact target.
calibration.scale: Constant scale equal to the SD of the period's unrestricted residuals; concentrated scale multiplies it by sqrt(0.2 + 4.8 x_perp^2 / mean(x_perp^2)); crisis scale multiplies it by 5 inside the period's declared episodes and 0.6 outside.
calibration.errors: Unit-variance AR(1) e_t = rho e_{t-1} + sqrt(1 - rho^2) u_t on the full weekly calendar with 300 burn-in weeks; MA(1) e_t = (u_t - 0.8 u_{t-1}) / sqrt(1.64); u Gaussian or Student t(4)/sqrt(2).

means.slope_drift: (u_t - 0.5) x_t, u_t the calendar position in [0, 1] within the period
means.nuisance_drift: 0.25 * SD(y) * (2 u_t - 1) * m_t, m the period-standardized month-end-week indicator

calibration.empirical_ar1: Calendar lag-1 autocorrelation of the period's unrestricted residuals
calibration.crisis_note: A period without a declared episode (pre_strains) has no crisis cells; its mandatory set is the other 32 cells.

standard.two_sided: Every mandatory cell's 95% Wilson lower bound on coverage of the exact target is at least 0.94.
standard.one_sided: Every mandatory cell's 95% Wilson upper bound on each one-sided rejection rate at the exact target is at most 0.06.
standard.scope: Status applies per period and width; a failure is reported and never tuned away (no change to widths, controls, dates or thresholds).

precision_subset.method: Exact inversion of every subset simulation: total length of bounded sets, share unbounded, share disconnected.
precision_subset.null_offsets_note: Rejection rate of the two-sided test of a null displaced by the offset from the exact target; equivalently, power against a true value displaced by minus the offset from a fixed null.

calibration.audit_fields: Each cell row records the AR(1) coefficient and residual SD actually used.

fallback: If a period fails, its coefficient is shown descriptively with no interval and the failure is stated.
